title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Exclusions: Deferred Installments Counted
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, Premier 150 exclusion schedule: the deferral count.** The deferral part of the Premier excluded total counts some or all of the installments deferred by every extension the Retail Installment Contracts contract records. The total deferred is the sum, over all of those extensions, of the installments each one deferred.

| Installments deferred by all extensions together | Deferred installments counted |
|---|---|
| one in total | none |
| two | all but one, so one |
| three | all but one, so two |
| none, or four or more | all of them |

*Hypothetical case.* Two extensions deferred one and three installments, so four are deferred in total. All four are counted.
